There are multiple store driver implementations (sqlite/postgres/mysql). Determine which one runs by default. Check the default driver config (profile defaults) and find the CreateMemo INSERT implementation for that driver. Format: "concrete method — path; determination method (how you determined which of the candidates runs)"

h13 (dispatch): Markdown processing sits behind an interface. Which concrete implementation(s) execute at runtime, who constructs them, and which components hold the interface? Look in internal/markdown/, plugin, and how the parser/renderer is used. Format: "impl — construction — holders"

Report premise correction + actual caching mechanism (in-memory? what library?). Format: "premise correction + actual mechanism"

Give concrete file:line citations. Report in a numbered list h03, h04, h12, h13, r01.

content.text:
All information gathered. Here are the findings.

## Answers

**h03 (idp abstraction / implementation)**
`internal/idp`; `internal/idp/oauth2`

- The abstraction package is `internal/idp` at `/bench/repo/internal/idp/idp.go`. It defines the shared cross-provider type `IdentityProviderUserInfo` (idp.go:3) that every provider implementation returns. (Note: there is no Go `interface` keyword type in the package — the abstraction is this shared package/contract; `grep interface internal/idp/` returns nothing.)
- The one concrete protocol implementation that ships is package `oauth2` at `/bench/repo/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`, with `IdentityProvider` struct (oauth2.go:20), `NewIdentityProvider` (oauth2.go:27), `ExchangeToken` (oauth2.go:47), and `UserInfo` (oauth2.go:83). It is constructed at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:121`.

**h04 (MySQL constructed directly outside factory?)**
no; The MySQL `DB` struct is only constructed via `mysql.NewDB` (`/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`, which builds `driver := DB{...}` / `return &driver` at lines 29/40). The sole caller of `mysql.NewDB` is the driver-selection factory `NewDBDriver` at `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go:22`. A codebase-wide grep for `&DB{` inside `store/db/mysql/*.go` non-test files returns nothing; the only direct `&DB{}` literals are in tests (`/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`). So outside the factory it is never constructed in production code.

**h12 (which CreateMemo runs by default)**
`(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (INSERT at memo.go:41); determination method: the default driver is `sqlite`, set in `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go` at `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` (line 122) and the `--driver` flag default `"sqlite"` (line 130). The factory `NewDBDriver` (`/bench/repo/store/db/db.go:18-20`) switches on `profile.Driver`, so with no DB flags it dispatches to `sqlite.NewDB`, and thus `sqlite.CreateMemo` executes the INSERT.

**h13 (markdown impl / construction / holders)**
impl: the unexported `service` struct implementing `markdown.Service` (`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`, interface at markdown.go:31), which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` (markdown.go:59, built in `NewService` at markdown.go:103) and, for markdown-to-markdown rendering, `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` (markdown.go:250, 451) — construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` (markdown.go:85), called in production at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` (with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()`) and `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54` for RSS — holders (fields typed as the `markdown.Service` interface): `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), and `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:45`).

**r01 (Redis / cache TTL premise)**
premise correction: There is no Redis anywhere — the cache layer is a self-contained thread-safe **in-memory** cache. No Redis client, connection string, or third-party cache library is imported; `/bench/repo/store/cache/cache.go` uses only the standard library (`sync.Map`, `sync/atomic`, `time`). The `Cache` struct stores entries in a `sync.Map` (cache.go:67-73), created via `New`/`NewDefault` (cache.go:76, 88) with a background `cleanupLoop` goroutine (cache.go:200). There is no user-specific TTL; a single default TTL of **10 minutes** applies to all entries (`DefaultConfig` → `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, cache.go:59), overridable per-entry via `SetWithTTL` (cache.go:98). Cleanup runs every 5 minutes (cache.go:60) with a 1000-item cap (cache.go:61).
